analysis.executive_summary: Documentation audit of docs.port.io covered 894 pages with 100% crawl coverage across a single-product topology. The site contains 8 confirmed broken internal documentation links and 5 unverified links excluded from counts due to authentication or rate-limiting. API reference coverage is complete at 100% across 411 detected API pages. Critical weaknesses include low example reliability at 52.14% and minimal freshness visibility with only 7.72% of pages displaying last-updated metadata. Overall audit confidence stands at 76.12%, with links confidence notably lower at 56.54%.
strengths: Complete crawl coverage at 100% with 894 pages successfully indexed
Full API reference coverage at 100% across 411 API pages detected
Zero broken repository navigation links; all 8 broken links are user-facing documentation links
Strong crawl confidence at 95% and API detection confidence at 85%
risks: Example reliability critically low at 52.14%, indicating over half of code examples may be outdated or non-functional
Freshness metadata present on only 7.72% of pages, preventing users from assessing content currency
8 confirmed broken internal documentation links degrade user navigation experience
5 unverified links due to authentication/rate-limiting represent unknown documentation quality gaps
Links confidence at 56.54% suggests potential undetected link issues beyond confirmed breaks
Overall confidence of 76.12% indicates moderate uncertainty in audit completeness
Large page count (894) with minimal freshness tracking creates maintenance blind spots

prioritized_actions.action: Implement automated example testing pipeline to validate code samples and raise reliability above 85%
Fix all 8 confirmed broken internal documentation links immediately
Deploy last-updated timestamps across all 894 pages with automated git-based tracking
Investigate and resolve 5 unverified links blocked by authentication or rate-limiting
Establish quarterly link validation process to address 56.54% links confidence gap

limitations: External audit cannot verify accuracy or correctness of technical content, only structural and linking integrity
Example reliability is estimated through heuristics; actual code execution and functional testing not performed
Authentication-protected pages and rate-limited endpoints (5 unverified links) could not be fully validated
Freshness assessment relies solely on visible metadata; actual content currency requires subject matter expert review
API coverage detection may miss non-standard API documentation patterns not matching common reference page structures
